title: Renyi diversity profiles
description: Renyi generalised entropy for each sample over a range of alpha orders.

sample_dim.title: Sample dimension
sample_dim.description: Name of the sample dimension of the abundance matrix.

taxon_dim.title: Taxon dimension
taxon_dim.description: Name of the taxon dimension of the abundance matrix.

scales.title: Alpha scales
scales.description: Renyi alpha orders to evaluate; 0 is richness, 1 is Shannon.

include_inf.title: Include Inf
include_inf.description: Append the alpha = Inf limit (log of the reciprocal of the maximum proportion).

hill.title: Hill numbers
hill.description: Exponentiate the profiles to return Hill numbers instead of entropies.
